digest.component_or_area: ticket store push and worktree management
propositions: rebar must not use git stash in the tickets worktree because the stash stack is shared across all linked worktrees of a repository
the stash->merge->pop dance in push.py can apply stashes created in other worktrees, corrupting the ticket store index and stranding writes
the tickets worktree must be converted from a linked worktree to a standalone clone to eliminate shared stash stack access
the auto-heal mechanism must classify and discard foreign paths (not tracked on tickets branch, not ticket-shaped) to recover from stranded indexes without human intervention
a supported maintenance entrypoint is required with backup-before-first-write, refusal on unpushed commits, durable audit logging, and an explicit break-glass override for exceptional cases
